hero.title: ImpAct-Climate Micro-Grants
hero.description: Empowering colleges and institutes across Canada to lead climate action through innovative, community-driven projects. Explore the impact of micro-grant funded initiatives tackling waste, energy, biodiversity, and more.
hero.imageAlt: Aerial view of lush Canadian forest representing climate action

storytelling.headline: Driving Change Across Canada
storytelling.paragraph1: Through the ImpAct-Climate Micro-Grants program, colleges and institutes across Canada are transforming how their communities respond to the climate crisis. From innovative waste reduction strategies to groundbreaking biodiversity projects, these initiatives are creating real, measurable change.
storytelling.paragraph2: Each funded project represents a unique partnership between students, faculty, and community members working together to build a more sustainable future. The results speak for themselves — reduced emissions, restored ecosystems, and empowered communities.
storytelling.paragraph3: This program demonstrates that meaningful climate action starts at the local level, with institutions that are deeply connected to the communities they serve.
storytelling.quote: "These micro-grants have been a catalyst for change — empowering our students to become the climate leaders of tomorrow."

about.heroSubtitle: Learn more about CICan and the ImpAct-Climate Micro-Grants program.
about.missionP1: Colleges and Institutes Canada (CICan) is the national voice of Canada's publicly supported colleges, institutes, CEGEPs, and polytechnics. Through the ImpAct-Climate initiative, CICan empowers member institutions to lead meaningful climate action in their communities.
about.missionP2: The ImpAct-Climate Micro-Grants program provides targeted funding to colleges and institutes, enabling them to launch innovative projects that address pressing environmental challenges — from waste management and energy efficiency to biodiversity conservation and indigenous land stewardship.
about.missionP3: By investing in grassroots, community-driven projects, the program cultivates the next generation of environmental leaders while delivering tangible benefits to local ecosystems and communities across Canada.
about.partnersSubtitle: The ImpAct-Climate initiative is made possible through the generous support of our partners and sponsors.
